prompts.authoritative_location_line: Location: Calderan Slave Market. A public, legal slave market in Calderan's West District, publicly known, about 20 minutes' walk from Heartstone. Its very large square exceeds Main Market Square: practical packed earth, gravel and dirt, muddy in poor weather, sometimes dirtied by blood and animal/human traffic. This major economic center has heavy daytime traffic: buyers, sellers, slaves, caravans, handlers, clerks, guards, spectators and auctions. Slavery is legal and socially accepted; ordinary attendance is not clandestine. The complex operates around the clock, formal auctions primarily by day, direct purchases outside auction hours, much less activity at night. The general authorized public auction has no named operator. Low-level authorized clerks handle required ownership documentation at official auction sales; licensed private sellers handle or arrange their own authorized sale documentation. No routine health certification requirement is established; no systematic doctors or medical inspection are present. They do not operate the public auction. The taboo Back Alleys and deeper criminal layer are distinct. No dominant origin or percentages: sources may include war prisoners, convicted criminals, hereditary slavery, debt, economic ruin, refugees, criminal trafficking, vulnerable Beastfolk, captured elves, bandit/criminal-associated captives and other legally processed or illicitly laundered captives. Not every refugee, Beastfolk or elf is enslaved.
